title: Mongol sack of Baghdad
summary: Hülegü’s forces sack Baghdad and kill the last widely recognized Abbasid caliph there.
body: The destruction of libraries is proverbial and partly literary. The political fact is the end of a caliphal capital that had defined Sunni high culture for centuries. Editorial draft for this timeline, not a substitute for specialist literature.

sources.name: Kennedy, The Court of the Caliphs
